title: marketing.customer_360
description: Marketing view of each customer: segment, consent, lifetime value and last order.

email.description: Email address for campaigns. Personal data.

segment.description: Commercial segment assigned by sales operations.

marketing_opt_in.description: Whether the customer agreed to marketing messages.

lifetime_value.description: Total order amount over the customer's life, in INR.

last_order_at.description: When the customer last ordered; null if they never have.
